description.value: Naked Cafe is a fully plant-based restaurant and coffee bar established in 2015 by three sisters, now a fixture in downtown Kelowna on Lawrence Avenue between Safeway and The District mall. The cafe is licensed to serve local beer, wine, and spirits alongside its vegan comfort food — PETA named their Market Poutine best in the country. It hosts a lively events calendar including monthly brunch buffets, jazz nights, and a weekly Vegan Meet Up, making it a welcoming stop for cyclists exploring the Okanagan.
